with claude on the PATH, setup runs:
  claude mcp add --scope user factory -- maku mcp

otherwise: add this to ~/.claude.json (maku setup never edits a config):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "factory": {
      "command": "maku",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}

setup installs the factory-handoff skill in ~/.claude/skills
and the /factory command (handoff, status, inbox) in ~/.claude/commands
